important_uncertainties: East Asia is strongly supported by the 2021 genomic model, but Asian/wild germplasm remains undersampled.
The ~12,000 BP domestication and ~4,000 BP hemp/drug divergence dates are model-based estimates.
Presence/use/cultivation/domestication must not be treated as equivalent.
The exact mechanism by which early high-psychoactivity cannabis emerged is unresolved.
